apply.action: Complete preflight and freeze immutable backup+manifest digest before any target/staging write.

Exclusive nonrecursive parent-first mkdir /Users/ZGH/.local/run, /Users/ZGH/.local/run/lcb-attest, /Users/ZGH/.local/share/lcb-daemon-attestation; mode0700 uid502 gid20; lstat/realpath and ledger dev/ino immediately. Unexpected existence stops; never adopt.

Install3 exact frozen-source files through exclusive sibling staging; mode0500 uid502 gid20; verify bytes/length/hash/owner; fsync; atomic rename to still-absent target; fsync parent; ledger new inode.

Stage exact proposed wrapper bytes, mode0700 uid502 gid20; verify length/hash and fsync; revalidate original wrapper and baselines; atomic rename over exact wrapper; fsync parent; ledger new inode. Preserve original wrapper permissions.
Reread all installed target hashes/bytes/mode/owner and unchanged baselines; refresh exact Tunnel PID/start immediately before restart; freeze restart_before in receipt.
Only this exact target; record result even if uncertain. No kickstart retry, broad kill, bootout/bootstrap, Desktop termination or other service restart.
Start single90000ms acceptance deadline immediately after kickstart returns; retry bounded read-only gates only; never repeat target mutation/kickstart.
Pass all gates before shared deadline, reread final identities/hashes and write success receipt. Any failure enters rollback. No candidate deploy in this invocation.

files.contract.json: exact externally frozen canonical contract bytes
files.manifest.json: canonical immutable JSON frozen before first target write
files.manifest.sha256: 64 lowercase hex of exact manifest.json bytes plus LF; exclusive mode0600
files.original-wrapper.bin: exact original385 bytes, backup mode0600; preserve original mode/uid/gid in manifest
files.owned-targets.jsonl: mode0600 append-only exact creation/replacement/staging ledger with invocation,path,dev,ino,type,mode,uid,gid,hash,created_by_this_invocation
files.result.json: mode0600 receipt with contract/manifest digest, success/rollback/retained paths; no secrets or protocol bodies

backup.freeze_rule: Write evidence exclusively; fsync original-wrapper.bin/contract.json/manifest.json; compute exact manifest SHA256; persist manifest.sha256 exclusively, fsync file and backup directory; freeze digest in controller handoff outside writable backup. Reread frozen manifest/backup-wrapper digest/metadata and all absence states before first target write. On mismatch abort; never recalculate an accepted digest.
backup.invocation_id_rule: bootstrap-<UTC YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSmmmZ>-<crypto.randomBytes(16).toString(hex)>; timestamp digits/T/Z only; random suffix32 lowercase hex; exclusive mkdir; collision aborts; never reuse
backup.preparation_exception: Backup root/invocation directory/evidence files are the only pre-freeze writes; they are evidence paths, not bootstrap targets. Record creation ownership; no host code or runtime directory write before manifest freeze.
backup.retention: Retain invocation backup/manifest/digest/receipts on success or rollback; retain created backup root because evidence makes it nonempty. Never recursively delete backups.

canonicalization.digest: SHA-256 of exact file bytes; freeze externally before execution; no self digest
canonicalization.format: UTF-8 JSON; recursively lexicographically sort object keys; preserve array order; compact JSON.stringify; exactly one final LF; no BOM

execution_record.acceptance: canonical bytes/currentness readback; independent review pending
execution_record.selection_reason: precise host-contract closure, single writer and read-only evidence

live_prestate.host_code_sha256_scope: Complete original host baseline for preflight and rollback. After apply only wrapper path may differ; require unchanged_host_code_sha256 plus proposed wrapper target hash/mode/owner.
live_prestate.identity_currentness: PIDs/start/runs are observations, not permanent authority; refresh exact service identity into invocation manifest. Wrapper/absent paths/parent directories/frozen hashes must still match or stop before any target mutation.

original_wrapper.bytes:

set -eu

# Private stdio target for OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel.
# The tunnel control-plane credential must not reach the Bridge process.
unset CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY
export CODEX_EXE=/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/CodexCLI.app/Contents/MacOS/codex
exec /opt/homebrew/bin/node /Users/ZGH/.local/share/local-codex-bridge/dist/src/index.js

preflight: Require uid502/gid20; lstat every ancestor of target/backup paths, reject symlinks or realpath aliases; preserved parent directory dev/ino/mode/uid/gid must match live_prestate.

Verify exact canonical contract against external frozen digest, verifier SHA256 and verifyAnchoredPackage(candidate7); hash archive/manifest/all install and verification modules. Do not regenerate candidate7.

Require original wrapper exact385 bytes/hash/mode0700/uid502/gid20; all absent targets still absent. Verify production Git HEAD/index/all dist hashes/unchanged host hashes and exact LaunchAgent/tunnel/direct-Bridge identity.

Before target mutation require healthz/readyz200, control-plane poll PID equals running Tunnel, original wrapper initialize/exactly8 tools/codex_models limit1. Report original service health separately from unavailable daemon attestation.
Create only backup evidence paths, exclusively and without symlinks; freeze complete backup manifest+digest before any bootstrap target directory, file or staging write.
release_followup: candidate.7 freezes prebootstrap host hashes; after authorized bootstrap, freeze independently reviewed host hashes including all three external hook files and wrapper and reseal a new candidate before --deploy. Do not overwrite candidate.7 or relax identity checks.

rollback.completion: Report original service restoration separately from cleanup; rolled_back=true only after exact wrapper/baseline/service verified and owned cleanup complete. If service restored but safe retained owned artifacts remain, report old_service_restored=true, cleanup_incomplete=true, rolled_back=false with retained paths. If service/backup/identity verification fails, MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED; no broad kill/fallback restart.
rollback.directory_cleanup_rule: rmdir only when prestate absent AND ledger created_by_this_invocation AND current dev/ino/type/mode0700/uid502/gid20 match AND still empty. /Users/ZGH/.local/run removable only with these conditions; added content from any consumer means preserve.
rollback.freeze_guard: Verify manifest against external frozen invocation digest, original-wrapper.bin against manifest and contract prestate; never recalculate accepted digest. Mismatch -> MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED; preserve evidence, do not overwrite unknown files.
rollback.old_service_verification: Separate90000ms shared window/max18 attempts/5s interval: original wrapper exact bytes/hash/mode/owner; original direct Bridge command under exact running Tunnel with uid/parent/start, changed PID after rollback restart; unchanged production baseline/Git/host; healthz/readyz200/control-plane PID equal Tunnel; original wrapper initialize/exactly8 tools/codex_models limit1; real remoteModels gate; identities stable. Old wrapper has no daemon attestation: old_service_restored=true and baseline_daemon_attestation=unavailable reported separately; disk/probe hashes do not prove old daemon loaded bytes.
rollback.owned_cleanup: After all bootstrap-preloaded Bridge/probes exit, unlink only own hook/staging files matching ledger path/dev/ino/hash/mode/uid/gid. Hook owns its exact socket exit cleanup; never remove unknown/stale/socket files. Retain/report nonempty runtime directory or persistent socket; no recursive deletion.
rollback.preserved_paths: Never chmod/chown/remove preexisting .local/.local/bin/.local/share; retain backup evidence.

restart.condition: If apply kickstart attempted including uncertain result, restore wrapper then one exact rollback kickstart; record prior PID/start and prove replacement. If no apply kickstart, prove old service still exact preflight instance; no restart needed.

rollback.restore_wrapper: If replaced and current wrapper matches owned inode/proposed hash/mode/uid/gid, stage original-wrapper.bin exact385 bytes/mode0700/uid502/gid20; verify b7c4ece43cb0478db49251941bedfd3a59348480c56c190015428b461ed7d77d; fsync and atomic restore plus parent fsync. If never replaced and still original, prove unchanged and skip. Unexpected identity blocks restoration.
rollback.trigger: Any post-first-mutation write/readback failure, kickstart failure/uncertainty, deadline/gate/identity/final hash failure.

staging.rule: Exact sibling <target-parent>/.lcb-bootstrap-<invocation_id>-<target-basename>.tmp; O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW, no reuse; initial0600, enforce final target mode/uid/gid before rename. Ledger exact path/dev/ino/hash. Cleanup only exact owned identity; no globs/recursive deletion.
